name: Question 3
problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & -9 \\ -3 & 2 & 12 \\ -6 & -4 & -3\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 3 \\ -3 & 2 & 12 \\ -12 & 0 & 21\end{aligned}]
$$

By applying elementary row operations of the form ${R}_{i}:={R}_{i}+k{R}_{2},$ the matrix $A$ can be transformed into the matrix $B.$ What are the elementary row operations?
worked_solution:
To transform $A$ into $B,$ we need to make the entries above and below ${a}_{22}=2$ equal to $0.$

To do this, we can apply the following elementary row operations:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}3 & -2 & -9 \\ -3 & 2 & 12 \\ -6 & -4 & -3\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+{R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 3 \\ -3 & 2 & 12 \\ -6 & -4 & -3\end{aligned}] &  & \,\begin{aligned}{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+2{R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 3 \\ -3 & 2 & 12 \\ -12 & 0 & 21\end{aligned}] \\  & =B\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the elementary row operations are

$\,$ ${R}_{1}:={R}_{1}+{R}_{2}\,$ and $\,{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+2{R}_{2}.$

Question 3
?

A=[3−2−9−3212−6−4−3],B=[003−3212−12021]

By applying elementary row operations of the form Ri:=Ri+kR2, the matrix A can be transformed into the matrix B. What are the elementary row operations?

a
R1:=R1+R2 and R3:=R3−2R2
b
R1:=R1−R2 and R3:=R3−2R2
c
R1:=R1+2R2 and R3:=R3+R2
d
R1:=R1+R2 and R3:=R3+2R2
e
R1:=R1−R2 and R3:=R3+2R2
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

To transform A into B, we need to make the entries above and below a22=2 equal to 0.

To do this, we can apply the following elementary row operations:

A=[3−2−9−3212−6−4−3]R1:=R1+R2∼[003−3212−6−4−3]R3:=R3+2R2∼[003−3212−12021]=B

Therefore, the elementary row operations are

R1:=R1+R2 and R3:=R3+2R2.
